spans.s: व्राज॑ m. host, multitude.
व्र॑जन n. wandering, way, road.
व्रजनाथ m. lord of the folds, E. of Kṛṣṇa.
व्रजसुन्दरी f. sheperdess.
व्रज˚स्त्री f. sheperdess.
व्रजाङ्गना f. the same.
व्रजि॑न् a. being in a stable.
व्र॑ज्य a. belonging to a fold.

व्रज्या f. going, motion;
 group, class.
व्रण m. (n.) wound, sore, fracture, scar, rent.
व्राण॑ a. shut up, confined.
व्रणन n. piercing, perforating.
व्रणय् व्रण˚यति pp. व्रणित wound.
व्रणयुक्त a. wounded.
व्रणवन्त् a. wounded.
व्रणविरोपण a. & n. healing wounds.
व्रणितहृदय a. having a wounded heart.
व्रणिन् a. wounded, sore.
व्रणिल a. wounded, sore.
व्रा॑त m. heap, troop, multitude, community, corporation.

व्रतग्रहण n. making a vow i.e. becoming a monk or
ascetic.

व्रतचारि॑न् a. performing vows, fulfilling the duties
of (—˚).
व्रत॑ति f. creeping plant, creeper.
व्रत॑पति m. the lord of vows or devotion.
व्रा॑तपति m. lord of a host or band.
व्रतपा॑ a. maintaining ordinances or sacred duties.

व्रतपारण n. conclusion of a vow, esp. of fasting,
breakfast.
व्रतभृ॑त् a. maintaining the holy work.
व्रतमीमांसा॑ f. examination of observances.

व्रतरुचि a. fond of vows or religious observances,
devout, pious.

व्रतलोप m. ˚न n. breach or violation of a vow or
observance.
व्रत॑वन्त् a. observing a vow or religious duty.

व्रतसंपादन n. performance of a vow or religious
observance.
व्रतस्थ a. observing a vow or religious duty.
व्रत˚स्थित a. observing a vow or religious duty.
व्रतादान n. = व्रतग्रहण.

व्रतादेश m. ˚न n. instruction in the performance of
vows.

व्रति॑न् a. = व्रतवन्त्, also observing, honouring,
behaving like (—˚).
व्रतेश m. = व्रत॑पति, E. of Śiva.
1 व्रत्य॑ a. obedient, faithful (gen.).

व्रा॑त्य m. vagrant, tramp, outcast;
 abstr. ˚ता† f.

†व्रद्^1 व्रद्ते become soft or weak.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160418. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/289. note: verbs don't have anubanDa in CAE, so virAma missing..
व्रन्दि॑न् a. softening, weakening (tr. or intr.).
व्र॑यस् n. overwhelming power.

व्रश्च् वृश्च॑ति pp. वृक्ण॑ hew down, fell (a tree), cut
to pieces. — अपि hew off or asunder. अव cut off, sever. आ sever,
separate, estrange or alienate from (dat. or loc.). नि hew down, fell.
परि cut, mutilate. प्र cut or split off. वि cut or split asunder.
सम् hew or cut in pieces.
व्र॑श्चन a. & n. hewing, felling, cutting.
व्रा॑ f. troop, band.
व्रातीन a. belonging to a wandering band, vagrant.
†व्राध् (व्राधते) stir up.
